comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The black variant of the Dolphin Anchor, it is produced via R12 Handicrafts recipe available from Aide Fleet (India region). A certain amount of contribution is required for the Aide Fleet recipes to appear. Ingredients:

x1 Platinum Ore
x30 Iron
x5 Steel

Source: yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-613.html

wiki:
Period: On 1st 20:00 ~ On 8th 19:59:59(server time) probably.
Recipe Book: Clothes Sewing Secret Book (India)
Recipe Name" "Making an Anchor with a Dolphin Decoration"
Required Skill: Handicrafts 12R

Materials:
Steel X 5 + Platinum Ore X 1 + Iron X 30
